pinterestResearch.title: Environmental Graphic / Wayfinding
pinterestResearch.evidence: Indexed Pinterest board, 27 ideas; full page 403.
pinterestResearch.designInference: Use one coherent sign family: same icon footprint, same label alignment and a predictable hierarchy.
pinterestResearch.reuse: Reference only; no image reuse license established.

pinterestResearch.title: Future of Waiting Areas — Changi Airport Singapore
pinterestResearch.designInference: Calm airport architecture can establish place without becoming a moving decoration behind reading. Preserve an unobstructed architectural opening and a stable information plane.
pinterestResearch.reuse: Reference only; no image reuse license established.

pinterestResearch.title: Premium brand identity design for healthcare brand
pinterestResearch.designInference: Consistent typography and generous clear labels matter more than extra glossy badges. Hospital support should read as calm service information.
pinterestResearch.reuse: Reference only; no image reuse license established.

pinterestResearch.title: Lattice wall detail with accent lighting, warm whites and stone
pinterestResearch.evidence: Indexed Pinterest pin title; pixels not reviewed.
pinterestResearch.designInference: Restrained material cues and a single plausible light direction can add depth; avoid luminous rings and multiple competing glow effects.

additions.gap: Adds practical support contact instructions absent from current room data and visit insights. Does not change room access, hours or verification dates.

en.title: Ask for a chaplain
facts: For urgent support, use the telephone number displayed in a prayer room and ask for the Duty Chaplain.
en.caveat: Prayer or religious rites depend on availability.

fr.title: Demander un aumônier
facts: Pour une aide urgente, appelez le numéro affiché dans une salle de prière et demandez le « Duty Chaplain ».
fr.caveat: La prière accompagnée et les rites religieux dépendent des disponibilités.

ar.title: اطلب الدعم الروحي
facts: للدعم العاجل، اتصل بالرقم المعلّق في غرفة الصلاة واطلب المرشد الروحي المناوب «Duty Chaplain».
ar.caveat: تُقدَّم الصلاة أو الشعائر الدينية حسب التوافر.

es.title: Pedir apoyo de capellanía
facts: Para ayuda urgente, llama al número indicado en una sala de oración y pide hablar con el « Duty Chaplain ».
es.caveat: La oración acompañada y los ritos dependen de la disponibilidad.

source.title: University of Bristol — Places to Worship

additions.gap: The existing Bristol record retains four dedicated Muslim prayer spaces. These are additional quiet/multifaith options, not replacements and not claims about ablution facilities.

en.title: More quiet spaces on campus
facts: The Quiet Room at 1 Woodland Road opens weekdays 11:00–15:00.
The Students’ Union multifaith space is on the 4th floor of the Richmond Building, 08:00–23:00.
en.caveat: Listed for university students and staff of all faiths and beliefs.

fr.title: D’autres espaces calmes sur le campus
facts: La Quiet Room au 1 Woodland Road ouvre en semaine de 11 h à 15 h.
L’espace multiconfessionnel du Students’ Union se trouve au 4e étage du Richmond Building, de 8 h à 23 h.
fr.caveat: Espaces destinés aux étudiants et au personnel, de toutes confessions et convictions.

ar.title: مساحات هادئة أخرى في الحرم
facts: تفتح الغرفة الهادئة في 1 Woodland Road خلال أيام الأسبوع من 11:00 إلى 15:00.
تقع المساحة متعددة الأديان لاتحاد الطلاب في الطابق الرابع من Richmond Building، وتفتح من 08:00 إلى 23:00.
ar.caveat: مخصّصة لطلاب الجامعة وموظفيها من جميع الأديان والمعتقدات.

es.title: Más espacios tranquilos en el campus
facts: La Quiet Room en 1 Woodland Road abre entre semana de 11:00 a 15:00.
El espacio multiconfesional del Students’ Union está en la 4.ª planta del Richmond Building y abre de 08:00 a 23:00.
es.caveat: Para estudiantes y personal de la universidad de todas las creencias.

source.title: Guy’s and St Thomas’ — Spiritual care

additions.gap: Extends the existing bedside support insight with an arrival action. Keep existing restricted-access caveat and prayer-mat/Quran information.

en.title: Tell staff what support you need
facts: You can register your faith or belief when giving your arrival contact details, or tell your nurse.
en.caveat: Prayer rooms remain for patients, relatives during their stay, and staff only.

fr.title: Précisez le soutien dont vous avez besoin
facts: Vous pouvez indiquer votre religion ou conviction lors de l’enregistrement de vos coordonnées à l’arrivée, ou en parler au personnel infirmier.
fr.caveat: Salles de prière réservées aux patients, à leurs proches pendant le séjour et au personnel.

ar.title: أخبر الموظفين بالدعم الذي تحتاجه
facts: يمكنك تسجيل دينك أو معتقدك عند تقديم بيانات التواصل لدى وصولك، أو إخبار طاقم التمريض.
ar.caveat: تبقى غرف الصلاة مخصّصة للمرضى وذويهم أثناء الإقامة والموظفين فقط.

es.title: Indica qué apoyo necesitas
facts: Puedes registrar tu religión o creencia al facilitar tus datos de contacto al llegar, o decírselo al personal de enfermería.
es.caveat: Las salas siguen reservadas a pacientes, familiares durante su estancia y personal.
